personality_one_liner: A rugged, high-contrast, industrial-grade tool built for logistics yards—large targets, hard alignment, and zero decorative friction.

spacing.rule: Use rigid grids, exposed structure, and deliberate tension. Forms should have clear boundary lines. Use md for internal card padding, lg for layout margins.

dont's: Do not use blur or glass effects anywhere. This is a brutalist, industrial app.

screens.name: Nueva Inspección (Wizard)
screens.purpose: Multi-step form capturing company info, 19 inspection points, activity report, and signatures.

states.error: Faltan campos obligatorios. Scroll al primer error.

screens.layout: Sticky progress bar at the top (e.g., 'Paso 2 de 4: 19 Puntos'). Step 1: General data form. Step 2: 19 checklist items as a stack. Each item has a title and two large touch targets: 'Bueno' (turns solid green) / 'Malo' (turns solid red). If 'Malo' is selected, automatically expand a text input for 'Comentarios'. Step 3: Suspicious activity text area. Step 4: Two canvas areas for digital signatures. Sticky 'Siguiente' / 'Guardar' button at the bottom.

screens.name: Detalle Inspección
screens.purpose: Read-only view of a completed inspection with PDF generation and sharing.
screens.layout: Header with summary and large 'Exportar PDF' action button. Content organized in strict, receipt-like blocks with mono-spaced labels for keys (Placas, Tráiler, etc.) and bold values. Signatures displayed as images at the bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Brutalist Mobile Light design. Do NOT use blur or glassmorphism. Use flat surfaces, sharp corners (radius 0 or very small), and strong borders.
Implement offline support as a priority. Show a persistent banner 'Modo offline' when the device loses connection.
The 19-point checklist must be highly ergonomic for gloved hands. Use large toggle buttons for 'Bueno'/'Malo' instead of small radio buttons or checkboxes.
Conditional logic in the checklist: The 'Comentarios' field should only appear if the inspector selects 'Malo'.
Use react-native-signature-canvas or expo-signature-pad for the drawn signatures of the Inspector and Verificador.
For PDF generation, use expo-print to generate a PDF from an HTML template and expo-sharing to share it.
Ensure high contrast text. Avoid light grays for text; use onSurfaceSecondary (#09090B) for legibility in sunlight.
Do NOT use any emojis in the UI. Rely on Phosphor icons with filled/regular variations.
